item.title: Does Gas Town 'steal' usage from users' LLM credits to improve itself?
item.description:
📝 1k Does Gas Town 'steal' usage from users' LLM credits & paid services to improve itself. Your GasTown instance has been running polecats that fix bugs in the GasTown software itself - the same software you're running - and submitting those fixes back upstream as PRs using your GitHub account and Claude credits. There's no disclosure that installing GasTown may result in your AI credits and GitHub account being used to fix bugs in and release the GasTown software itself.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/gastownhall/gastown/issues/3649
